crossRefs.note: Why do the nations rage, and the peoples plot a vain thing?
Therefore I will give thanks to you, Yahweh, among the nations, and will sing praises to your name.
I will declare your name to my brothers. Among the assembly, I will praise you.

Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
Yes, they will sing of the ways of Yahweh, for Yahweh’s glory is great!
All your works will give thanks to you, Yahweh. Your saints will extol you.

translations.web: I will give thanks to you, Lord, among the peoples. I will sing praises to you among the nations.
translations.bsb: I will praise You, O Lord, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
translations.kjv: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.
translations.asv: I will give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the peoples: I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.
